curation.notes: Imported from validation panel. Original serotype: Ouakam. Panel notes: Co-existence of multiple serotypes detected, indicating potential inter-serotype contamination. See 'Extracted_antigen_alleles.fasta' for detected serotype determinant alleles.

reads.download_cmd: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir data/ SRR1288359 && mv data/SRR1288359_1.fastq.gz data/reads_1.fq.gz && mv data/SRR1288359_2.fastq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz

SeqSero2.run_cmd: SeqSero2_package.py -m a -t 4 -i data/reads_1.fq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz -d actual/seqsero2/ -n seqsero2

SeqSero2S.run_cmd: SeqSero2S_package.py -m a -t 4 -i data/reads_1.fq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz -d actual/seqsero2s/ -n seqsero2s

validation_instructions.serological: Expected serotype: Ouakam. Antigenic formula should match 9,46:z29:-. WARNING: Inter-serotype contamination detected in this sample. Tool may report multiple serotypes or ambiguous results.
validation_instructions.mlst: Expected ST1610. Accept exact match. Flag novel alleles for manual review.

notes: Part of FDA-CFSAN validation panel. Co-existence of multiple serotypes detected, indicating potential inter-serotype contamination. See 'Extracted_antigen_alleles.fasta' for detected serotype determinant alleles.
